scripts.seed: bun --env-file=.env run uv run --project scripts --frozen python scripts/seed_content.py
scripts.dev:agent: bun --env-file=../../.env run --cwd apps/agent uv run python agent.py dev
scripts.dev:worker: bun --env-file=../../.env run --cwd apps/agent uv run python async_worker.py
scripts.lint:python: cd apps/agent && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pyright
scripts.lint:python:fix: cd apps/agent && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.lint:ts: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:mobile && bun run typecheck:server && bun run typecheck:web && bunx eslint --max-warnings 0 . && bunx prettier --check 'apps/**/*.{ts,tsx}' 'apps/web/**/*.{html,css}' 'packages/**/*.ts' 'e2e/**/*.ts'
scripts.lint:e2e: cd e2e && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx tsc --noEmit && bunx eslint --max-warnings 0 .
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:python
scripts.lint:fix: bunx eslint --fix . && bunx prettier --write 'apps/**/*.{ts,tsx}' 'apps/web/**/*.{html,css}' 'packages/**/*.ts' 'e2e/**/*.ts' && bun run lint:python:fix
scripts.test:server: bun --env-file=../../.env test --cwd apps/server --path-ignore-patterns='**/{db,locations-load.integration,invite-store}.test.ts' && REQUIRE_DB=1 bun --env-file=../../.env test --cwd apps/server src/db.test.ts && REQUIRE_DB=1 bun --env-file=../../.env test --cwd apps/server src/locations-load.integration.test.ts && REQUIRE_REDIS=1 bun --env-file=../../.env test --cwd apps/server src/invite-store.test.ts
scripts.test: bun --env-file=.env test ./scripts && bun test --cwd packages/shared && bun test --cwd packages/design-tokens && bun run test:server && bun test --cwd apps/mobile && bun test --cwd apps/web && bun test e2e/require-environment.test.ts
scripts.test:python: bun --env-file=../../.env run --cwd apps/agent uv run pytest tests/ -q -m "not acceptance" -n 8
scripts.test:acceptance: TESTCONTAINERS_RYUK_DISABLED=true bun --env-file=../../.env run --cwd apps/agent uv run pytest tests/acceptance -m acceptance -q
scripts.test:acceptance:nollm: TESTCONTAINERS_RYUK_DISABLED=true bun --env-file=../../.env run --cwd apps/agent uv run pytest tests/acceptance -m "acceptance and not real_llm and not openai_real_llm and not live_voice" -q
